description.value: Liberty Wine Merchants is one of the largest independent private fine wine retail chains in Western Canada, operating since 1986 with six Metro Vancouver locations. The Commercial Drive shop sits on one of Vancouver's most vibrant and cycling-friendly corridors, stocking an extensive selection of wines, spirits, craft beer, cider, and sake. Cyclists exploring East Van could stop in for a BC bottle to take back to camp or a local accommodation.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 24m; stands (3 spaces) at 76m; rack at 94m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 98m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Liberty Wine Merchants operates a Commercial Drive location at 1622 Commercial Drive, matching the OSM address. The website shows the head office phone (604.739.7801) but does not list a separate phone for the Commercial Drive location, so the OSM phone (+1-604-633-1922) cannot be confirmed or denied. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention any cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or washrooms.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-604-633-1922) could not be verified against website; website lists only the head office number (604.739.7801), not a per-location phone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Liberty Wine Merchants is a legitimate, active retail business on the cycling-friendly Commercial Drive corridor, but it is a liquor store rather than a food-service venue, and none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. On-the-ground verification of cycling amenities is needed before including.
